title: Chrome cache folders
whyItMatters: Cached pages, images and scripts show which sites were visited and often still hold the page content itself, even after history was cleared.
source: XDG Base Directory spec (caches go to $XDG_CACHE_HOME, default ~/.cache) plus the Chromium cache layout under the user data directory: https://specifications.freedesktop.org/basedir-spec/latest/
notes: One cache tree per profile (Default, Profile 1, ...) with Cache, Code Cache and GPUCache inside. If XDG_CACHE_HOME is set the cache lives there instead. Chromium itself uses ~/.cache/chromium.
